name: ICT-Center Vaduz
notes: Colocation/cloud facility of ICT-Center AG at Schwefelstrasse 5A, Vaduz 9490. Only facility physically located in the Vaduz municipality; no capacity figures published. Listed in Data Center Catalog and Data Center Map aggregates.

name: Kyberna Balzers Data Center
notes: High-availability colocation facility at Fabrikstrasse 4, Balzers 9496 (Balzers municipality, grouped under Vaduz by aggregate listings). Officially opened April 2011, approx. 200 sqm; offers colocation, cloud, virtualization and IT outsourcing. No capacity MW published.

name: SpeedCom Schaan Data Center (ex-Newsnet)
notes: Data center at Im alten Riet 153, Schaan 9494 (Schaan municipality). Operated by Newsnet AG, which SpeedCom AG acquired in February 2016 to expand its hosting/housing datacenter business; lie:zeit (2017) confirms SpeedCom datacenter locations Schaan and Ruggell. Facility has redundant UPS, diesel generator and high-availability cooling. No capacity MW published.

name: SpeedCom Ruggell Data Center
notes: Data center at Industriering 14, Ruggell 9491 (Ruggell municipality, northernmost Liechtenstein). lie:zeit (2017) lists SpeedCom AG datacenter locations as Schaan and Ruggell. No capacity MW published.

name: SupraNet Schaan Data Center
notes: Colocation/data center at Im alten Riet 121, Schaan 9494 (Schaan municipality), operated by Supranet AG; advertises a 100 Gbit/s fiber backbone and nationwide high-speed network expansion in Liechtenstein. No capacity MW published.
